title: Signs, nameplates, and operation and emergency shut-down instructions.
officialText:
Signs, nameplates, and operation and
emergency shut-down instructions for refrigeration systems shall comply with the following:
1. Sections 9.15, 11.2.1, 11.2.2, 11.2.4, and 11.7 of ASHRAE 15.
2. Each refrigeration unit or system shall be provided with a nameplate indicating the horsepower of the prime mover or
compressor and the equivalent of such horsepower in kilowatts.
3. Section 1105.11 of this code.
